## Getting started

### Prerequisites

- **Python 3.7+** — the scripts are written in Python and use only the standard library.

### Running the tools

All helper scripts live under `scripts/`. To run one, pass any arguments after the script path.

```bash
# Regenerate .gitignore with new entries (e.g., build artifacts)
python scripts/update_ignore.py *.pyc __pycache__/ .eggs/

# You can also pass a single entry at a time
python scripts/update_ignore.py .tox/
```

The script reads any existing entries from `.gitignore`, merges them with the new entries you provide, sorts everything, removes duplicates, and writes the result back. Entries are managed under a `# managed ignore rules` header — hand-written comments or entries above that header are left untouched."}
